name: Flat ground
description: One big concrete floor with four spawns. A clean canvas for building your own layout.

name: Arena
description: Walled square with a raised center platform, four ramps, pillars and cover. Set up for every mode.

name: Warehouse
description: Indoor hall with corrugated walls, crate stacks, support columns and a catwalk reached by stairs.

name: Rooftops
description: Eight buildings around a plaza, joined by bridges. Stairs lead up from the plaza.

name: Street
description: A city block: road with a center line, curbs and sidewalks, buildings on both sides and parked cover.

name: Downtown Crossroads
description: A four-way intersection between city blocks: office towers, shops with awnings, alleys, a courtyard, parked cars, a crashed bus and a climbable roof.

name: Civic Plaza
description: A grand square with a fountain, colonnades and planters, between two courthouses with raised porticos and wide steps.

name: City Park
description: Lawns, crossing paths, ponds, a gazebo in the middle, a playground and lots of trees. Long sightlines broken up by greenery.

name: Mall Parking Lot
description: A huge lot between two mall entrances: rows of parked cars, light poles, cart corrals and planted islands. Cars are the cover.

name: Gas Station Corner
description: Two gas stations face off across a highway: pump islands under canopies, convenience stores, billboards and parked trucks.

name: Train Yard
description: Parallel tracks full of boxcars, a station platform, fuel tanks and a footbridge over the rails.

name: Harbor Docks
description: Two quays around a shallow harbor basin with piers, moored boats, gantry cranes, container stacks and warehouses.

name: Suburban Cul-de-sac
description: Houses with gabled roofs, porches, picket fences and yards around a cul-de-sac. A backyard pool, mailboxes and parked cars.

name: Trailer Park
description: Rows of trailers with porches, junk cars, propane tanks and laundry lines, a park office in the middle and a chain-link fence around it all.

name: Chinatown
description: A main street under a grand gate, lined with shops, colored awnings, glowing signs and market stalls, with lanterns overhead and side alleys.

name: Skyscraper Site
description: A three-story concrete frame rising in steps, with stairs between floors, a tower crane, materials yards and site trailers.

name: Rooftop Run
description: A grid of buildings at three heights joined by ramps across the streets. Climb from the street and run the rooftops.

name: Highway Interchange
description: Two elevated roads cross at different heights over a street level of pillars and barriers. Ramps link the ground, the low deck and the high deck.

name: High School
description: Two U-shaped school buildings face each other across a football field with bleachers, a basketball court, buses and a flagpole.

name: Bus Terminal
description: Covered platforms between parked buses, a ticket hall at each end and an overhead walkway with stairs at both ends.

name: Housing Projects
description: Tall apartment blocks around courtyards with a playground, a half court, dumpster rows, chain-link fences and a parking lot.

name: Warehouse District
description: Big warehouses with raised loading docks, trucks backed up to the doors, forklifts, pallet stacks and a rail spur.

name: Canal District
description: A sunken canal runs through the middle, crossed by three bridges. Cafés, steps down to the water, moored boats and townhouses on both banks.

name: Junkyard
description: Stacks of wrecked cars, a car crusher, scrap heaps, tire piles and a magnet crane, inside a corrugated fence.

name: Church Square
description: A stone church with a bell tower in the middle of a tree-lined square, graveyards on both sides and row houses around the edge.

name: Club Strip
description: A boulevard of nightclubs with glowing pink and cyan fronts, entrance canopies, velvet ropes, limos and colored light everywhere.

name: River Bridge
description: A road bridge and two footbridges cross a river. Steps lead down to the riverside paths under the bridge; warehouses and lofts line both banks.

name: Farmers Market
description: An open square packed with market tents and food trucks under string lights, with a raised music stage in the middle.

name: Burned Block
description: A burned-out city block: broken walls of different heights, rubble heaps, gutted cars and fire barrels glowing orange.

name: Main Street
description: A classic main street: storefronts with awnings, a diner, a theater with a marquee, side alleys, phone booths and a water tower on a roof you can climb.

name: Office Park
description: Glass office towers around a landscaped courtyard with reflecting pools, a parking deck with a rooftop level, and a sculpture garden.

name: Stadium Plaza
description: The plaza outside a stadium: ticket booths, turnstile rows, statues, merch stands and a raised concourse ring around the stadium wall.

name: Speedball Field
description: Tournament turf with logo-printed inflatables: snake, doritos, cans, a cake, a temple, a maya and the big X in the middle. Behind the side boards: team pits, referee towers, scoreboards, a stand, gear and air.

name: Rooftop Paintball
description: A gravel roof with parapets, AC units, vents, a satellite dish, stair bulkheads and two water towers you can climb for the high ground.

name: Container Yard
description: Shipping containers in lanes, some stacked two high, with stairs onto a container roof for a sniper spot. Floodlights in the corners.

name: Parking Garage
description: Each team starts on an upper deck with a ramp and stairs down to the parking level, where cars sit in their bays and barriers give cover.

name: Back Alleys
description: City blocks with narrow alleys, dumpsters, trash bags and barrels around a fountain plaza. Fire escapes up the side of two blocks lead onto their roofs.

name: Tire Yard
description: A dirt lot of tire stacks, cable spools, pallets and plywood walls around a big tire pile, with referee towers, an air station and banners on the fence.

name: Construction Site
description: A half-built concrete frame with an open upper floor, beam and rebar stacks, drain pipes, sand piles, a cement mixer, site lights and plywood barricades.

name: Street Court
description: An open basketball court in the middle (the kill zone), hoops at both ends, with bleachers, benches, cars in their bays, dumpsters and brick walls around it.

name: Subway Station
description: Two tiled platforms with yellow edges over a sunken track with stopped train cars. Stairs climb from the tracks; pillars, benches and vending machines line the platforms.

name: Skate Park
description: Quarter pipes, a funbox with ramps on every side, ledges, grind rails and a stair set, with benches and floodlights. Fast, flowing fights.

name: Bunker Village
description: Plywood huts with doorways, sandbag lines, a fire pit, washing on the line and two lookout towers flying the team flags. Clear huts room by room or hold a tower.

name: Night Market
description: A cobbled street of market stalls under strings of lanterns, with produce crates, carts and a pagoda in the middle.

name: Overpass
description: An elevated highway crosses the middle on pillars. Fight on the deck between stalled cars, or under it behind jersey barriers and the exit signs.

name: Neon Grid
description: A glowing grid floor with a checkerboard of neon blocks at different heights, a ramped tower in the middle and jump pads up onto the blocks beside it.

name: Data Core
description: A round arena around a towering core of falling code. Ramps climb to the core ring; glowing conduits and code pillars break up the floor.

name: Circuit Board
description: Shrunk down onto a motherboard: chips to climb, capacitors and resistors for cover, gold traces and a CPU with a heat sink.

name: Hex Hive
description: A honeycomb of hexagonal pillars at four heights. Weave through the gaps; grab the laser RPG on the low center hex.

name: Server Farm
description: Rows of blinking server racks with tight aisles at both ends, and an open floor with cooling units and a manned control desk in the middle.

name: Sky Islands
description: Floating platforms at different heights over a glowing void floor, joined by neon bridges and ramps, round a core of falling code.

name: Neon Ziggurat
description: A four-tier stepped pyramid with stairs up every face and a laser RPG on top, ringed by glowing obelisks.

name: Holo Maze
description: A maze of glowing walls on a 10-unit grid with short sightlines everywhere. The laser RPG waits in the very center.

name: Neon Skyline
description: Glowing towers at different heights linked by sloped neon bridges. Spawn on your home tower behind its holo billboard; the street far below has stairs back up.

name: Cyber Colosseum
description: An octagonal pit ringed by tiered neon seating up to a walkway round the top, with a ramped platform under a four-sided scoreboard in the middle and blocks for cover.

name: Three Lanes
description: Three long lanes split by glowing walls with gaps to cross between them. Each base has a sniper deck over the middle lane, and jump pads in the side lanes lead up onto ledges.

name: Reactor
description: A glowing reactor core on a ramped platform between two huge cooling towers, with raised pipes, coolant pools and control rooms.
